extracted.intended_audience: general public, journalists, consumer protection stakeholders, regulated entities
extracted.subtask_description: A news/announcements listing page from the Federal Trade Commission's Bureau of Consumer Protection that aggregates press releases and related case/proceedings entries with brief summaries and metadata. Used to browse recent enforcement actions, notices, and related case information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press Release (label/header)
rubrics_metrics.description:
The page groups items under the header 'Press Release' to indicate news items and announcements (e.g., 'Press Release
FTC to Co-Host Workshop on Financial Services...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each press-release item is presented with a headline and a short lead/summary. Use the 'Press Release' label to identify official FTC announcements on this listing page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date
rubrics_metrics.description:
Each press-release item displays a 'Date' (e.g., 'Date
May 7, 2026').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the publication date prominently with each press release to indicate timeliness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead summary paragraph / excerpt
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases include a short paragraph summarizing the action (e.g., 'The Federal Trade Commission will co-host a workshop on May 14-15, 2026, with George Mason University Law School’s Institute for Consumer Financial Choice (ICFC) focusing on developments in the...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise opening summary that states the core action or announcement; the listing shows truncated excerpts for browsing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cases and Proceedings (section header)
rubrics_metrics.description: The listing intermixes 'Cases and Proceedings' entries alongside press releases to surface ongoing matters (header: 'Cases and Proceedings').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this section to list case-specific items and link to more detailed case pages; distinguish these from press-release items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Case metadata fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Case/proceedings entries include structured metadata fields displayed on the listing: 'Type of Action', 'Last Updated', 'FTC Matter/File Number', and 'Case Status' (examples shown for multiple matters).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide these metadata fields for each case entry so users can quickly see procedural posture and identifiers; include consistent labeling and values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket Number (when available)
rubrics_metrics.description:
Some case entries show a 'Docket Number' (e.g., 'Docket Number
3:25-cv-03477') especially for federal litigation matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include docket numbers for litigation-related items to enable cross-referencing with court records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adjudicative Proceedings (detailed narrative)
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain items are grouped under 'Adjudicative Proceedings' and include a more detailed narrative description of enforcement actions and allegations (example: detailed paragraph describing the FTC lawsuit against Uber).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the adjudicative proceedings section to present fuller descriptions of enforcement actions, allegations, and legal bases where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Result count display
rubrics_metrics.description: The page shows the number of results and the current slice being displayed (e.g., 'Displaying 1 - 20 of 5863').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Display total results and current range to orient users browsing the archive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pagination/navigation
rubrics_metrics.description:
Pagination controls are provided ('Current page
1
Page
2
Page
3 ... Next page ›› Last page') to navigate through the list of items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear pagination controls (page numbers, next/last) for large archives; indicate current page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concise headline + metadata grouping
rubrics_metrics.description: Each listing item combines a concise headline, a short summary, and metadata (date or case fields) into a single browseable entry (examples throughout the page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structure listing entries so users can scan headlines and metadata quickly; lead with a clear headline followed by essential metadata and a one-sentence excerpt.
